_how: Place card, Norte roll-out of the golden sample (operator's step 2, 3 Nov 2026). Read by scripts/map-data/tiles.py together with routes.csv, schools.csv and health.csv in this folder. The free card shows the rows marked card=1 and the chosen beach, city and airport; every row goes to the paid analysis (site/src/data/mapanalysis.json). Flights: facts.csv rows (PlaneMapper scheduled block times, checked 2026-11-03). SOURCES.md in this folder says how each figure was checked.
